cvStructure.issue: Your CV is missing a phone number, which recruiters and ATS forms often expect alongside your email and location.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a phone number near your email and location at the top of your CV.

sectionOrganization.issue: The heading "About Me" is a personal label rather than a standard section name.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Rename "About Me" to "Summary" so ATS systems recognize it correctly.

sectionOrganization.issue: The heading "My Journey So Far" is a creative label instead of a standard section name for your work history.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Rename "My Journey So Far" to "Experience" or "Work Experience".

sectionOrganization.issue: Your AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and Scrum Fundamentals Certified credentials are listed inside the Skills section instead of their own section.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Move these two certifications into a separate "Certifications" section so recruiters and ATS can find them easily.

keywordUsage.issue: React and JavaScript are written inconsistently across your CV: "Reactjs", "React.JS" and "React" all appear, and "java script" and "Javascript" both appear; also "Postgress" in the Maktabati stack is a misspelling of PostgreSQL.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Use the official forms consistently everywhere: "React", "JavaScript", and "PostgreSQL".

keywordUsage.issue: In the Najm Logistics Solutions entry, making the app "check itself automatically every time someone saved new code so that mistakes are found early" describes continuous integration but doesn't name it.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add the term "continuous integration (CI)" to that bullet so it matches what recruiters search for, if that is what you set up.

keywordUsage.issue: PostgreSQL is used in both the Maktabati and Souq Tracker projects but is not listed in your Skills section.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add PostgreSQL to the Skills section under a database tools category.

readability.issue: The Najm Logistics Solutions entry is written as one long first-person story covering many tasks in a single block of text.
readability.suggestion: Split it into short bullet points, each starting with an action verb like "Optimized", "Collaborated" or "Implemented", and add a specific result such as [percentage] where you can.

readability.issue: The Campus IT Help Desk bullets ("Responsible for bugs", "Meetings with team", "Tickets and emails from students") list duties instead of describing what you did.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite each line starting with an action verb, for example "Resolved [number] student support tickets" or "Tracked and reported software bugs to the development team".

readability.issue: The About Me section uses vague, generic phrases like "excellent skills" and "a great passion for technology" instead of concrete information.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite it as a short, specific summary mentioning your degree, your key skills such as React or Node.js, and your target role as Software Engineer.

contentFormatting.issue: The Najm Logistics Solutions dates read "Jun 2025 - Aug 2024", which means the end date comes before the start date.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Correct the dates for this internship so the end date matches when it actually ended, for example Jun 2025 - Aug 2025.
